slides.title: Welcome to Misinformation and Deepfakes
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on Misinformation and Deepfakes.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to identify how **AI** creates fake content.
Next, you will understand the risks of deepfakes.
Finally, you will apply strategies for source verification.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration:
You will need a device with internet access.
A web browser is also required.

slides.title: Prerequisites
slides.narration:
Basic knowledge of **AI** concepts is helpful.
No prior deepfake experience is needed.

slides.title: **AI** and Fake Content
slides.narration:
Can **AI** create things that are not real?
Yes, **AI** can generate very realistic fake content.
It uses complex algorithms for this.
This includes images, videos, and audio.

slides.title: How Deepfakes Are Made
slides.narration:
Think of **AI** as a skilled artist.
It learns from many real examples.
Then it creates new, fake versions.
These fakes look very convincing.

slides.title: Risks: Deepfake Audio
slides.narration:
What are the dangers of deepfakes?
Deepfake audio can mimic any voice.
Criminals can use this for scams.
It makes it hard to trust phone calls.

slides.title: Risks: Deepfake Video and Images
slides.narration:
**AI** can swap faces in videos.
It can also alter images easily.
This spreads false information fast.
It can harm reputations greatly.

slides.title: Real-World Deepfake Examples
slides.narration:
Let's see some real examples.
A politician's fake speech went viral.
Fake celebrity videos also appeared.
These caused much public confusion.

slides.title: Societal Impact of Deepfakes
slides.narration:
You saw the impact.
Now reflect.
Deepfakes erode public trust.
They can influence elections.
This threatens our society greatly.

slides.title: Verify Your Sources
slides.narration:
How can we fight deepfakes?
Always check the source of information.
Look for official and trusted channels.
Do not believe everything you see.

slides.title: Importance of Media Literacy
slides.narration:
We need strong media literacy skills.
Question unusual details in content.
Use reverse image searches sometimes.
This helps us identify fake content.

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you learned about deepfakes.
We saw how **AI** creates fake content.
We discussed the risks involved.
We also explored source verification methods.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Find a news article about deepfakes.
Identify the type of deepfake discussed.
Write two sentences on its potential impact.
